JSZip 3.10.2 browser-bundle dependency notices
================================================

The version list below follows the upstream JSZip 3.10.2 package manifest and lock file:
https://github.com/Stuk/jszip/blob/v3.10.2/package.json
https://github.com/Stuk/jszip/blob/v3.10.2/package-lock.json

The bundle includes or references these dependency modules:

* lie 3.3.0 — MIT. Copyright (c) 2014-2018 Calvin Metcalf and Jordan Harband.
* immediate 3.0.6 — MIT. Copyright (c) 2012 Barnesandnoble.com, llc, Donavon West, Domenic Denicola, Brian Cavalier.
* readable-stream 2.3.6 — MIT. Copyright Node.js contributors; also contains code originating from the Joyent Node repository, Copyright Joyent, Inc. and other Node contributors.
* setimmediate 1.0.5 — MIT. Copyright (c) 2012 Barnesandnoble.com, llc, Donavon West, and Domenic Denicola.
* core-util-is 1.0.2 — MIT. Copyright Node.js contributors.
* inherits 2.0.3 — ISC. Copyright (c) Isaac Z. Schlueter.
* isarray 1.0.0 — MIT. Copyright (c) 2013 Julian Gruber.
* process-nextick-args 2.0.0 — MIT. Copyright (c) 2015 Calvin Metcalf.
* safe-buffer 5.1.1 — MIT. Copyright (c) Feross Aboukhadijeh.
* string_decoder 1.1.1 — MIT. Copyright Node.js contributors; also contains code originating from the Joyent Node repository, Copyright Joyent, Inc. and other Node contributors.
* util-deprecate 1.0.2 — MIT. Copyright (c) 2014 Nathan Rajlich.

Pako 1.0.5 is also bundled in the JSZip distribution. Its complete license text and notice are in PAKO-LICENSE.txt.

Upstream package references
---------------------------

* lie: https://www.npmjs.com/package/lie
* immediate: https://github.com/calvinmetcalf/immediate
* readable-stream: https://github.com/nodejs/readable-stream/tree/v2.3.6
* setimmediate: https://github.com/YuzuJS/setImmediate
* core-util-is: https://github.com/isaacs/core-util-is
* inherits: https://github.com/isaacs/inherits/tree/v2.0.3
* isarray: https://github.com/juliangruber/isarray
* process-nextick-args: https://github.com/calvinmetcalf/process-nextick-args
* safe-buffer: https://github.com/feross/safe-buffer/tree/v5.1.1
* string_decoder: https://github.com/nodejs/string_decoder/tree/v1.1.1
* util-deprecate: https://github.com/TooTallNate/util-deprecate
